summary: Completed comprehensive testing of pre-registration/recruitment open feature. All core functionality working correctly including dynamic countdown text, language switching, admin calendar management, and OG image switching.
passed_tests: ✓ Mobile (390x844) view: PRÉ-INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES displayed correctly when recruit_open is null
✓ Desktop (1920x1080) view: PRÉ-INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES displayed correctly when recruit_open is null
✓ Apply countdown shows 'DATE OFFICIELLE ANNONCÉE PROCHAINEMENT' when no official date set
✓ Apply intro text correctly shows 'pré-inscriptions sont déjà ouvertes' when recruit_open is null
✓ /suivi page countdown shows same PRÉ-INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES text
✓ English language switch (lang-switch-en) works correctly
✓ English version shows 'PRE-REGISTRATION OPEN' and 'OFFICIAL DATE ANNOUNCED SOON'
✓ Admin login successful with credentials admin@goldenpirates.io / Capitaine1023!
✓ Admin calendar (Calendrier des saisons) accessible and functional
✓ Setting recruit_open date (2027-01-15T19:00) via admin panel works
✓ After setting date: countdown shows 'OUVERTURE DES PORTES', 'J-87', '15 janvier 2027', and 'RECRUTEMENT OUVERT'
✓ After setting date: apply intro shows 'le recrutement est ouvert'
✓ English version after date set shows 'GATES OPEN', 'J-87', '15 January 2027', 'RECRUITMENT OPEN'
✓ GET /api/og-image.jpg returns 200 with valid JPEG image
✓ OG image switches from og-preinscription.jpg (186KB) to og-recrutement.jpg (184KB) when recruit_open is set
✓ OG image switches back to og-preinscription.jpg when recruit_open is reset to null
✓ HTML meta tags contain og:image with correct URL: https://golden-pirates.org/api/og-image.jpg?v=4
✓ API endpoint PUT /api/admin/season successfully updates calendar
✓ API endpoint GET /api/season returns correct recruit_open value
✓ Cleanup successful: recruit_open reset to null as required

pre_registration_state.details: When recruit_open is null, the system correctly displays 'PRÉ-INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES' and 'DATE OFFICIELLE ANNONCÉE PROCHAINEMENT' on both mobile and desktop views. The apply intro text correctly mentions 'pré-inscriptions sont déjà ouvertes'.

recruitment_open_state.details: When recruit_open is set to a future date (2027-01-15T19:00), the system correctly displays 'OUVERTURE DES PORTES', countdown timer 'J-87', formatted date '15 janvier 2027', and 'RECRUTEMENT OUVERT'. The apply intro text changes to 'le recrutement est ouvert'.

language_switching.details: Language toggle (data-testid='lang-switch-en') works correctly. English translations are accurate: 'PRE-REGISTRATION OPEN' / 'RECRUITMENT OPEN', 'OFFICIAL DATE ANNOUNCED SOON', 'GATES OPEN', etc.

admin_calendar.details: Admin panel accessible at /admin with correct credentials. Calendar section (Calendrier des saisons) allows setting recruit_open date. Changes persist and are immediately reflected on public pages.

og_image_switching.details: GET /api/og-image.jpg dynamically serves og-preinscription.jpg (186KB) when recruit_open is null, and og-recrutement.jpg (184KB) when recruit_open is set. Both images are valid JPEG 1200x630 format.

cleanup.details: Successfully reset recruit_open to null via PUT /api/admin/season. Verified via GET /api/season that recruit_open is null and OG image reverted to pre-inscription version.
